## Natural history notes

A small clubtail dragonfly characterized by a slender dark body, pale greenish to yellow markings, clear wings, and only a slight widening near the tip of the abdomen compared with larger clubtails. In Florida, the Cypress Clubtail is found along slow streams, rivers, cypress swamps, forested wetlands, and spring-fed or blackwater systems with shaded edges and sandy or silty bottoms. Adults perch on vegetation, logs, or bare ground near water and hunt small flying insects, while the aquatic nymphs live partly buried in bottom sediments where they ambush tiny aquatic prey.
